description: Project-local SOIL for ~/github/willow. Separate from fleet-global ~/.willow/store and from agent willow/* runtime collections. Collections are created on first write.

collections.governance/proposals: Envelope drafts and ratification queue (companion to envelopes/pre-approved.json proposals[])
collections.governance/decisions: Seat rulings and precedent (S4 — searchable decision log)
collections.governance/flags: Open governance shapes for this project — not fleet runtime flags

pm.question: What's in flight, by when, with what done-definition?

collections.pm/portfolio: Cross-repo threads (Schmidt, Die-Namic, py-chunk, charter ratification)
collections.pm/work_orders: Issued dispatch contracts with upfront verifiable claims (S3)
collections.pm/milestones: Dated deliverables, grant deadlines, envelope expiries

pa.question: What does the operator need, and when?

collections.pa/commitments: Calendar lane — due_at, kind, source, prep_bite (feeds willow_attention)
collections.pa/briefs: Call briefs, export checklists, paste-back intake stubs
collections.pa/intake: Parallel-channel recaps (Gemini, claude.ai) with provenance links

shared.sessions: Session metadata scoped to this project
shared.stack: Current focus stack for seat sessions in this repo

routing.fleet_global_read: Optional — kb_search, FRANK, handoffs remain fleet-global; this store holds project-operational state only
